notes: Local domain fixtures for FLIA-relevant topic testing. Live URL entries stay disabled by default.

entries.label: gov.cn-latest-policies
entries.note: Tried live 2026-09-22: this is a listing/nav page, not an article — extracted text is almost entirely site-navigation chrome, correctly deferred every time but produces no usable brief. Disabled again in favor of the chinanews.com.cn RSS entries below (real single-topic items, not a page to summarize). Re-enable only if pointed at an actual article URL.

entries.label: mofcom.gov.cn
entries.note: Tried live 2026-09-22: homepage is a multi-topic news index (dozens of unrelated headlines); the pipeline is built to analyze one article, so it stitched one real fact into a domain-template narrative that had nothing to do with that fact — technically not fabricated (the pulled number was real) but incoherent. Disabled in favor of the chinanews.com.cn RSS entries below. Re-enable only if pointed at a specific article URL, per the original note.

entries.label: ndrc.gov.cn-policy-release
entries.note: Tried live 2026-09-22: returns ~54 bytes (likely a JS-rendered shell or a soft block on this client) — fetchWhitelistedText's 20-char minimum drops it silently, no bad output, just nothing collected. Re-confirmed 2026-09-23 (still zero adopted briefs across two collect runs, just wasted quota slots): disabled in favor of the chinanews.com.cn RSS entries. Re-enable only if a better subpage/approach is found.

entries.label: CCTV-2 finance channel (text)
entries.note: Tried live 2026-09-22: fetches real content and is correctly deferred/rejected as thin by the pipeline (short consumer-lifestyle blurb, not policy substance) — honest behavior. Re-confirmed 2026-09-23: it's a channel homepage, not an article, so it structurally can never carry a named instrument/funding/deadline — same index-page problem as govcn-policy-index/mofcom-home above. Disabled; the chinanews.com.cn RSS entries are real single-article items instead. Text/article content only — broadcast video is out of scope (docs/DP-V3.md §2).

entries.label: CCTV-7 defense/military channel (text)
entries.note: Tried live 2026-09-22: fetches real content and is correctly deferred/rejected as thin (channel-description boilerplate, no article substance) — honest behavior. Re-confirmed 2026-09-23: same channel-homepage index-page problem as cctv-finance above, structurally never produces an adoptable article. Disabled. Text/article content only — broadcast video is out of scope (docs/DP-V3.md §2).

entries.label: China News Service — domestic/politics RSS
entries.note: Verified live 2026-09-22 (items dated same-day). Each RSS <item> is one article — solves the index-page incoherence problem the url-type entries above hit. Channel tier deliberately left "unknown": China News Service (中新社) has been under the United Front Work Department since the 2018 institutional reform, distinct from and junior to Xinhua — no citable source found yet for its precise institutional rank, so not force-fit into central_wire.

entries.label: China News Service — finance RSS
entries.note: Verified live 2026-09-22 (items dated same-day). See chinanews-politics-rss for tier rationale.

entries.label: China News Service — editors' headline digest RSS
entries.note: Added 2026-09-23 in place of chinanews-scroll-rss: same wire, but this is the editors' curated headline pick (要闻导读) rather than the raw minute-by-minute firehose, so it's less saturated with sports/culture human-interest filler. Does not meaningfully raise the adoption rate on its own (this remains a general wire, not a policy-instrument publisher — see public-live-collect subscription note) but wastes fewer of the run's item budget on stories the intake gate was always going to reject. See chinanews-politics-rss for tier rationale.

entries.label: China News Service — rolling news RSS
entries.note: Verified live 2026-09-22 (items updating same-day, minutes apart) — highest-frequency of the three chinanews.com.cn feeds, mixed topics. Disabled 2026-09-23: in a live test run this was mostly sports/culture/personnel-discipline items (moon cakes, Asian Games swim relay, corruption announcements), none adopted — swapped for chinanews-importnews-rss above. See chinanews-politics-rss for tier rationale.
